prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `isqrt` and `is_perfect_square` in src/lib.rs for the full `u64` range. `isqrt(n)` is the largest integer whose square is at most `n`. `is_perfect_square(n)` is true exactly when `n` is a perfect square, including 0 and 1. Do not use floating point. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
